newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian premier arrives in Minsk - TASS.
newsitem.headline: Russian premier arrives in Minsk - TASS.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin arrived in Minsk on Thursday to try to resolve a political crisis pitting President Alexander Lukashenko against the Belarus parliament, Itar-Tass news agency said.
Asked to comment on the report, a government spokeswoman said: "As far as I know he was planning to leave Moscow between 5 and 6 o'clock." She could not confirm he had arrived.
Were Chernomyrdin to have left Moscow between 5 and 6 p.m. (1400 and 1500 GMT), he could comfortably have completed the one-hour flight to the Belarus capital.
Tass said Chernomyrdin was expected to meet Lukashenko, who is insisting on going ahead with a controversial referendum on Sunday to extend his powers.

Lukashenko, who boycotted a meeting with Russian parliamentarians on Wednesday because Chernomyrdin was not there, had announced the meeting. But the Russian government had refused to confirm it was going ahead.
Moscow has appealed for a compromise in the standoff, in which Lukashenko's parliamentary opponents are seeking his impeachment, but neither side has shown any sign of backing down.
